Scrapes a simple HTML page and extracts title, description, and links

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.*;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
        var engineConfig = MAPPER.readValue("{\"max_depth\":0,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}", CrawlConfig.class);
        var engine = io.xberg.crawlberg.Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig);
        String url = "https://example.com";
        var result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url);
        System.out.println(result.statusCode());
        System.out.println(result.contentType());
        System.out.println(result.html());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().title());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().description());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().canonicalUrl());
        System.out.println(result.links().size());
        System.out.println(result.links().get(0).linkType());
        System.out.println(result.images().size());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().ogTitle());
    }
}
```
